newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 43 mln 1-yr bonds, min price flat.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 43 mln 1-yr bonds, min price flat.

text.p: Poland sold 43 million zlotys of its one-year bonds, due on June 4, 1998, after investors bid for 68 million at the 200 million zloty primary tender, the finance ministry said in a statement on Wednesday.
The minimum price of the bonds held flat at 92.50 from the previous auction on April 23. The average price at today's tender of was 92.79 and the maximum price was 93.10.
The settlement date for the tender is June 3, 1997.
